# Planner 5D

> > Planner 5D is a home design and renovation planning platform providing detailed cost estimators for construction materials, installations, and home improvement projects across the United States.

The platform offers comprehensive price breakdowns including labor costs, material costs, and installation pricing for hundreds of home renovation components. Cost data is sourced from industry standards including the US Bureau of Labor Statistics, helping homeowners and contractors budget accurately for projects ranging from flooring and windows to HVAC systems and outdoor structures.

## Key Topics

- Cost estimators and calculators
- Price per square foot calculations
- Installation costs and labor pricing
- Home renovation budgeting
- Material costs breakdown
- Construction pricing data
- HVAC systems (heat pumps, furnaces, AC units)
- Flooring materials (engineered wood, concrete)
- Windows and doors (vinyl, French doors, storm doors)
- Kitchen components (cabinets, cooktops, appliances)
- Exterior materials (siding, driveways, patios)
- Energy-efficient materials (Low-E glass, PVDF coatings)
- Countertops and surfaces
- Window treatments (blinds, shades)
- US Bureau of Labor Statistics data

## Flooring & Surfaces

- [Cost of Engineered Wood Flooring: Price Estimate per Square Foot](https://planner5d.com/costs/engineered-wood-flooring-cost): Engineered wood flooring costs per sq ft with veneer & subfloor pricing
